title: Boston Harbor Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: PLEASE UNDERSTAND THAT WE RESERVE THE RIGHT TO CANCEL RESERVATIONS AND REFUSE RENTALS DUE TO INCLEMENT OR DANGEROUS WEATHER CONDITIONS. Check Weather Underground (Boston Harbor, KWAOLYMP30) or call the Marina to check weather conditions. Choose from our stable, easy to handle Feel Frees (sit on top) or our performance Eddylines (sit in) for your adventure. We have single and tandem kayaks for rent. Kids 0-7 y/o can paddle with an adult in our Sit On Top single or double kayaks and kids 7 y/o and up (40+ lbs) can paddle alone in one of our child Sit on Tops. Be sure to let us know when you make your reservation if you have a child in your party so we can make sure we book your perfect boat!

blurb: Around since the 1920s, the marina is the heart of the Boston Harbor neighborhood and provides a relaxing, beautiful destination for all South Sounders. Located about 7 miles north of Olympia, Boston Harbor Marina sports amazing views of the Sound set against the backdrop of the magnificent Olympic Mountain Range.
